Fact.Name: Was k12 educators
Fact.Description: Whether the TP or secondary filer were k12 educators

Fact.Description: Whether the spouse was a k12 educator

Fact.Name: TP was k12 educator
Fact.Description: Whether the TP was a k12 educator

Fact.Name: Maximum Deduction for educator expenses
Fact.Description: The maximum deduction an individual can take for educator expense

Fact.Name: Primary educator expenses writable
Fact.Description: Expenses the TP spent as a k12 educator. May deduct up to the maxIndividualEducatorExpensesLimit. Enter qualified expenses NET of three of the four reductions the instructions list: nontaxable qualified tuition program earnings or distributions; any nontaxable distribution of Coverdell education savings account earnings; and any reimbursement received for these expenses that was not reported in box 1 of a Form W-2. Do NOT subtract the excludable U.S. series EE and I savings bond interest from Form 8815: the graph subtracts it (/educatorExpensesAdjustment), because Form 8815 line 9 is figured without that reduction. Enter the whole amount, even above the per-educator limit: the reductions come off the expenses before the limit, and the limit is applied to the result.

Fact.Name: primary educator expenses
Fact.Description: Expenses the TP spent as a k12 educator. May deduct up to the maxIndividualEducatorExpensesLimit. Handles the maximum conditions and eligibility to get a default 0. An entry below $0 counts as $0 (expenses paid are never negative).

Fact.Name: Secondary educator expenses writable
Fact.Description: Expenses the spouse spent as a k12 educator. May deduct up to the maxIndividualEducatorExpensesLimit. Enter qualified expenses NET of three of the four reductions the instructions list: nontaxable qualified tuition program earnings or distributions; any nontaxable distribution of Coverdell education savings account earnings; and any reimbursement received for these expenses that was not reported in box 1 of a Form W-2. Do NOT subtract the excludable U.S. series EE and I savings bond interest from Form 8815: the graph subtracts it (/educatorExpensesAdjustment), because Form 8815 line 9 is figured without that reduction. Enter the whole amount, even above the per-educator limit: the reductions come off the expenses before the limit, and the limit is applied to the result.

Fact.Name: Secondary educator expenses
Fact.Description: Expenses the secondaryFiler spent as a k12 educator. May deduct up to the maxIndividualEducatorExpensesLimit. Handles the maximum conditions and eligibility to get a default 0. An entry below $0 counts as $0 (expenses paid are never negative).

Fact.Name: Primary filer educator expenses entered, before the per-educator limit
Fact.Description: The primary filer's qualified educator expenses as entered (../primaryEducatorExpensesWritable), before the per-educator limit and before the Form 8815 savings bond reduction; $0 when that filer is not an eligible educator, and $0 on the joint dependent return whose question the interview never asks, as /primaryEducatorExpenses does. Floored at $0. Read by /educatorExpensesAboveTheLimit.

Fact.Name: Spouse educator expenses entered, before the per-educator limit
Fact.Description: The spouse's qualified educator expenses as entered (../secondaryEducatorExpensesWritable), before the per-educator limit and before the Form 8815 savings bond reduction; $0 when that filer is not an eligible educator, and $0 on the joint dependent return whose question the interview never asks, as /secondaryEducatorExpenses does. Floored at $0. Read by /educatorExpensesAboveTheLimit.

Fact.Name: Educator expenses entered above the per-educator limits
Fact.Description: The part of the entered educator expenses above each filer's per-educator limit: (/primaryEducatorExpensesEntered − /primaryEducatorExpenses) + (/secondaryEducatorExpensesEntered − /secondaryEducatorExpenses). The Form 8815 savings bond reduction comes off the expenses before the limit, so it is absorbed by this excess first and reduces the deduction only beyond it.

Fact.Name: The Form 8815 savings bond reduction that reaches the limited educator expenses
Fact.Description: Form 8815 line 14 (form8815 /form8815ExcludableSavingsBondInterestOrZero, $0 without a Form 8815) less /educatorExpensesAboveTheLimit, floored at $0: the part of the section 135 exclusion that the expenses above the limits do not absorb. On a joint return with two educators it reduces the primary filer's limited amount first and the spouse's with what remains; the total is the same either way (TAX-INTERPRETATIONS AD-26).

Fact.Name: Primary filer educator deduction after the Form 8815 reduction
Fact.Description: /primaryEducatorExpenses less /educatorSavingsBondReductionOfLimitedExpenses, floored at $0. The primary filer's part of Schedule 1 line 11.

Fact.Name: Spouse educator deduction after the Form 8815 reduction
Fact.Description: /secondaryEducatorExpenses less the part of /educatorSavingsBondReductionOfLimitedExpenses that the primary filer's limited amount did not absorb, floored at $0. The spouse's part of Schedule 1 line 11.

Fact.Name: Educator expenses deduction before the Form 8815 reduction
Fact.Description: The two per-educator limited amounts added and rounded, before the Form 8815 savings bond reduction. Form 8815 line 9 is figured with this figure ("do not reduce your educator expenses, if any, by the amount on Form 8815, line 14"), and so is every modified adjusted gross income the Form 8815 exclusion depends on: taxCalculations /adjustmentsExcludingStudentLoanIraAndSelfEmployedHealthInsurance reads it, which keeps the section 135 exclusion out of its own cone (TAX-INTERPRETATIONS AD-26). Schedule 1 line 11 is /educatorExpensesAdjustment.

Fact.Name: The Form 8815 reduction of Schedule 1 line 11
Fact.Description: /educatorExpensesBeforeSavingsBondExclusion less /educatorExpensesAdjustment: the amount by which the section 135 exclusion reduces the educator deduction. taxCalculations /adjustmentsToIncomeBeforeTerritoryApportionment subtracts it, so adjusted gross income carries the reduced line 11 while the modified AGIs read the unreduced figure.

Fact.Name: Educator Expenses Adjustment
Fact.Description: Schedule 1 line 11: the two per-educator amounts after the Form 8815 savings bond reduction (/primaryEducatorExpensesAfterSavingsBondExclusion + /secondaryEducatorExpensesAfterSavingsBondExclusion), rounded. Equal to /educatorExpensesBeforeSavingsBondExclusion on every return without a Form 8815 exclusion. California TY2025 reads this fact through its stateSystems export (Schedule CA (540), Schedule CA (540NR)).
